# log1pexpf

> Evaluates the [natural logarithm][@stdlib/math/base/special/lnf] of `1+exp(x)` as a single-precision floating-point number.

<section class="intro">

The function computes the natural logarithm of `1+exp(x)`, also known as the softplus function

<!-- <equation class="equation" label="eq:log1pexpf_function" align="center" raw="y = \ln(1 + e^x)" alt="Natural logarithm of one plus exponential"> -->

```math
y = \ln(1 + e^x)
```

<!-- </equation> -->

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var log1pexpf = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/log1pexpf' );
```

#### log1pexpf( x )

Evaluates the [natural logarithm][@stdlib/math/base/special/lnf] of `1+exp(x)` as a single-precision floating-point number.

```javascript
var y = log1pexpf( -10.0 );
// returns ~0.000045

y = log1pexpf( 0.0 );
// returns ~0.693147

y = log1pexpf( 5.0 );
// returns ~5.006715

y = log1pexpf( 34.0 );
// returns 34.0

y = log1pexpf( NaN );
// returns NaN
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var uniform = require( '@stdlib/random/array/uniform' );
var logEachMap = require( '@stdlib/console/log-each-map' );
var log1pexpf = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/log1pexpf' );

var opts = {
    'dtype': 'float32'
};
var x = uniform( 100, -10.0, 10.0, opts );

logEachMap( 'log1pexpf(%0.4f) = %0.4f', x, log1pexpf );
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<!-- C usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

### Usage

```c
#include "stdlib/math/base/special/log1pexpf.h"
```

#### stdlib_base_log1pexpf( x )

Evaluates the [natural logarithm][@stdlib/math/base/special/lnf] of `1+exp(x)` as a single-precision floating-point number.

```c
float out = stdlib_base_log1pexpf( 5.0f );
// returns ~5.006715f

out = stdlib_base_log1pexpf( 34.0f );
// returns 34.0f
```

The function accepts the following arguments:

-   **x**: `[in] float` input value.

```c
float stdlib_base_log1pexpf( const float x );
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="notes">

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<!-- C API usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

### Examples

```c
#include "stdlib/math/base/special/log1pexpf.h"
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdio.h>

int main( void ) {
    float x;
    float v;
    int i;

    for ( i = 0; i < 100; i++ ) {
        x = ( ( (float)rand() / (float)RAND_MAX ) * 20.0f ) - 10.0f;
        v = stdlib_base_log1pexpf( x );
        printf( "x: %f, f(x): %f\n", x, v );
    }
}
```

</section>
